title: Other actions.
bodyText: This chapter shall not interfere with a contractor's right to seek contribution, indemnity, or recovery against a subcontractor, supplier, or design professional for any claim made against a contractor by a claimant.
bodyHtml: [§672E-12]  Other actions.  This chapter shall not interfere with a contractor's right to seek contribution, indemnity, or recovery against a subcontractor, supplier, or design professional for any claim made against a contractor by a claimant. [L 2004, c 119, pt of §2]
